pixel_coords: full-resolution pixels, x right, y down, origin top-left

camera.evidence: phase correlation of frames 10/25/40/49 vs frame 0 below the cats: shifts < 0.03 px
camera.view: top-down (bird's-eye) view of a living room; floor plane is the image plane. Inner faces of left, right and top walls are visible (perspective camera looking straight down), but both cats walk on the same floor so one px scale applies to both.
camera.apparent_size_change: none systematic: black cat length (incl. tail) 183-200 px, tabby body length 237-283 px vary only with gait/tail pose

black_cat.description: all-black cat (small white hind paws), upper of the two cats (y~358), walks LEFT->RIGHT along +x for the whole clip
black_cat.reference_point: body_cx/body_cy (centroid of mask with thin tail removed by opening) = best origin proxy; cx/cy = full-mask centroid incl. tail

tabby_cat.description: orange/brown striped tabby cat, lower cat (y~450), walks RIGHT->LEFT along -x; starts from near rest, speeds up, slows to near stop at the end; tail curls up/down
tabby_cat.reference_point: body_cx/body_cy (mask centroid with tail removed) and torso_x/torso_y (frame-to-frame texture tracking of the back fur, smooth, may drift ~-20 px over the clip). See notes.md.
tabby_cat.artefact: a flat light-brown rectangular patch (~40x60 px) is rendered at the head end (left/front) and moves with the cat; it is included in the mask (it occupies where the head is).

events.event: black cat already walking at frame 0, steady ~11 px/frame to the right through frame 49 (no start/stop inside the clip)
tabby begins moving from near rest (torso step 0.5 px at frame 1, 2.5 at 2, 5 at 5)
cats pass each other (equal x of body centres; vertical separation ~95 px)
closest approach of masks: tabby white tail tip ~4 px from black cat tail (no clear contact)

wooden_slat_bench.description: orange-brown wooden slatted bench/rack, top-left, slats run vertically in image; long axis = x

tv_console_dark_cabinet.description: dark grey low cabinet/console along top wall; visible dark part x 697-1171 (right end hidden under lamp shade, visually the cabinet ends ~1265); top edge visually ~168 (mask top 150 includes wall shadow); bottom 292

pleated_lamp_shade.description: round white pleated lamp shade (seen from above) at right end of console, diameter ~146 px, centre ~(1190,224)

curved_sofa.description: large curved cream sofa, centre-bottom; outer bbox approx x 560-1450, y 518-1000 (mask top 535 misses the soft outline, +-10 px)
